\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,calc,shapes.multipart}
\begin{document}
\tikzset{
  detector/.style={
    rectangle split,
    rectangle split horizontal,
    rectangle split parts=5,
    rectangle split empty part width=1.5pt,
    rectangle split empty part width=2.5pt,
    rectangle split empty part height=.5ex,
    rectangle split empty part height=1.8ex,
    rectangle split empty part depth=.6ex,
    rectangle split part fill={cyan!14,white,yellow!20,white,red!12},
    draw,
    very thick,
    inner sep=3pt
  }
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[>=Latex]
  \node[detector,rectangle split empty part width=3pt] (levels)
    {$E_0$\nodepart{two}\nodepart{three}$E_1$\nodepart{four}\nodepart{five}$E_2$};
  \draw[->,thick,blue] ($(levels.two)+(0,1.25)$) -- (levels.two)
    node[above=2pt] {$h\nu_1$};
  \draw[->,thick,red] ($(levels.four)+(0,1.25)$) -- (levels.four)
    node[above=2pt] {$h\nu_2$};
  \draw[<->,gray,thick] ($(levels.west)+(0,-.65)$) -- ($(levels.east)+(0,-.65)$)
    node[midway,below] {detector bandwidth};
\end{tikzpicture}
